column1: # Original DICE TV Basketball, play-time potentiometer 60 kOhm (the maximum). One coin (500 ms) and
# Start (1500 ms) begin a two-player game; recorded closed-loop play (3000-20000 ms) scores, then the
# paddles rest until the timer ends the game; coin and Start (169000, 170500 ms) restart it. Original SDL int16 axes.
